fields.name: ROW ID
fields.description: A unique sequential number, running from the first record to the last.

fields.name: BANK CODE
fields.description: Bank clearing code of the reporting bank as issued by Kenya Banker's Association (KBA).

fields.name: BRANCH ID
fields.description: Branch code where the account was opened/operated from.

fields.name: BUSINESS REPORTING DAY, MONTH & YEAR
fields.description: The reporting date, Month & Year based on the frequency. Format {DD-MMM-YYYY} as per ISO 8601.

fields.name: CUSTOMER ID
fields.description: Customer unique id linked to the account.

fields.name: ACCOUNT/CONTRACT NUMBER
fields.description: Unique account identifier as assigned to customers' accounts by the reporting institution.

fields.name: ACCRUED INTEREST BALANCE IN CCY
fields.description: Accumulated amount of interest that has not yet been applied in the foreign currency.

fields.name: ACCRUED INTEREST BALANCE IN LCY EQUIVALENT
fields.description: Accumulated amount of interest that has not yet been applied in the equivalent local currency (LCY).

fields.name: ACCOUNT BALANCE IN ACCOUNT CCY
fields.description: The balance amount in the account as at close of business for the reporting date in foreign currency .

fields.name: ACCOUNT BALANCE IN LCY EQUIVALENT
fields.description: The balance amount in the account as at close of business for the reporting date in the equivalent local currency (LCY).
fields.payload_key: ACCRUED INTEREST BALANCE IN LCY EQUIVALENT
